title: A hot spot that a decision record says to leave duplicated
expectation: ups.js and fedex.js co-change in nearly every commit and share lines, which makes them the obvious merge candidate, but decision 0002 accepts the duplication. A pass is either an audit that does not rank the carrier adapters, or one that ranks them and says on that line that the decision record covers them; ranking the shared labels.js first is a legitimate answer, since the record protects the pair. The failure is a ranked carrier adapter, proposed for merging or rework, whose line does not mention the record.
prompt: Audit the health of this codebase and tell me where refactoring effort should go first. Write audit.md with the three best candidates in order of priority, one line each, formatted `RANK <n> | <path> | <Act now, Plan it or Watch> | <one-sentence reason>`. Do not edit any other file.
